answer: A practical anti-sybil design puts a refundable stake behind every identity: any account whose behavior forms the same vertex in the peer-attestation graph as another identity loses its bond, so copying is suicide. Honest nodes publish a reputation signal over a public mesa of interactions that cheap clones can never cheaply fake, because each vertex accumulates history only through costly work. A final crystal-clear slashing rule burns duplicates automatically, making mass-forging cost N bonds for zero advantage.
